overall_status: MATCH: the eight-case post-call projection (preorder, final rootlist, reordered component list, per-block index/visitcount/numdesc/copymap, out-edge and mirrored in-edge label classification, distinct-in-range index invariant) byte-matches the locked oracle; findIrreducible's copymap reuse, the structureLoops caller closure, and wiring the production pipeline onto the public port remain separate tasks
architecture: locked synthetic plain FlowBlock graphs built through production BlockGraph::newBlock/addBlock; no AddrSpace, no Funcdata, no PcodeOps (findSpanningTree touches only blocks, edges, and FlowBlock scalar state)
compiler_spec: not applicable: no Funcdata, no prototype model, no symbols (pure BlockGraph fixture)

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of locked BlockGraph::findSpanningTree on synthetic component graphs built through production BlockGraph APIs (newBlock/addEdge/setOutEdgeFlag); no Actions, SSA, or C emission
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh BlockGraph; one case pre-corrupts index=99/visitcount=5/copymap=other-block/numdesc=77 to observe the reset, and one case pre-labels out edges (f_irreducible|f_back_edge and f_goto_edge|f_loop_exit_edge, mirrored onto the in halves) to observe the pass-start wipe
analysis_options.observation: Per case: preorder vector, final rootlist order, final component list order (list = rpostorder), per-block index/visitcount/numdesc/copymap (self/other:name/null), every out edge slot->target with semantic label letters (g l d i t f c b x, '-' when unlabeled), every mirrored in edge slot<source with the same letters, and the distinct-index-in-[0,n) invariant
analysis_options.normalization: Block identity prints as creation-order names (b0..bn), never pointers. Edge labels print as semantic flag-set membership letters, not raw bits: Rugra's edge_flags bit assignments intentionally differ from Ghidra's (documented remap in src/block.rs edge_flags), and Rugra's F_TREE_EDGE shares bit 7 with F_DEFAULTSWITCH_EDGE (pre-existing collision); within this projection bit 7 is classified as tree because findSpanningTree wipes every edge label at the start of each pass and never sets default-switch labels. C++ numdesc/copymap garbage before the call is never observed (Ghidra leaves both uninitialized; Rugra marks them -1/None).

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: empty_graph_early_return: list.size()==0 immediate return leaves preorder/rootlist/list empty (block.cc:1012)
single_block: trivial root DFS assigns index 0, visitcount 0, numdesc 1, copymap self
single_entry_dag_corrupt_reset: diamond plus forward edge; tree/forward/cross classification, numdesc accumulation, and reset of pre-corrupted index=99, visitcount=5, copymap=b0, numdesc=77
multi_entry_rootlist_swap: two sizeIn()==0 roots; initial rootlist head/tail swap makes the original head finish last (RPO index 0) and the final swap puts it back at the front
no_root_assume_first_loop: every block has in-edges, so list[0] is assumed the entry; back edges labeled f_back_edge|f_loop_edge on both edge halves
unreachable_extraroots_twopass: an unreachable cycle component forces extraroots promotion and the second pass with the entry-block/origrootpos rootlist swap so the entry regains RPO index 0
stale_root_machinery: assumed entry plus cross/self-loop components exercise multi-root scanning order, tree edge into a previously finished entry, and self-edge label mirroring

irreducible_prelabel_wiped: pre-set f_irreducible|f_back_edge and f_goto_edge|f_loop_exit_edge labels on both edge halves are wiped by the pass-start clearEdgeFlags(~0) and the edges are classified afresh (RPO still covers every block)

observation_schema.format: Nine fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus eight case records
observation_schema.state: per-block index (reverse post order), visitcount (preorder number), numdesc, copymap identity
observation_schema.graph: preorder vector, final rootlist, final list order after list = rpostorder, per-slot out-edge and mirrored in-edge label classification, distinct-index invariant

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-block-index-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from the locked commit into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt there before the fixture is linked; no live worktree archive is consumed
build.private_state_observer: Read-only ABI observation of FlowBlock scalar fields (index/visitcount/numdesc/copymap) and both BlockEdge halves through #define private public and #define class struct (BlockGraph helper members are implicitly private without an access label) in the fixture translation unit only; no oracle source is modified
build.rust_comparand: A SHA-256-pinned full Rust crate snapshot is materialized from the pinned Rugra Git base with only src/block.rs overlaid; every registry archive is checked against Cargo.lock, safely expanded to a private vendor tree, and used through a private CARGO_HOME
build.environment_policy: Runner re-executes from an open file descriptor under an empty environment, verifies fixed toolchain/oracle/base identities, snapshots every mutable input, rebuilds the oracle archive, runs Cargo locked+offline against only the checksum-verified vendor tree, compares exact bytes, then hashes all owned inputs and the full Rust snapshot again

coverage.numdesc_accumulation: MATCH: numdesc equals subtree size +1 along the DFS tree in every case
